daw-standalone — WASM playback from remote storage

Host an .rpp + its audio sources at a public base URL (Nextcloud share link, S3 bucket, Cloudflare R2, any static host). The page loads the project structure, enumerates source paths via pathsToResolve(), fetches each one, decodes via AudioContext.decodeAudioData, and ships the PCM into the AudioWorklet via postMessage.
